name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: M23-led alliance and pro-government forces clash in the Kivus; no city changes hands
state: Clashes continued in late October in Walikale, Rutshuru, Minembwe and the Walungu highlands, with 'no operationally significant changes on the ground' (Critical Threats, 28 Oct). UNHCR counts 1.25 million Congolese refugees and asylum seekers in the region (allAfrica, 2 Nov). No major city had changed hands as of 3 Nov.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu.
rubric_hit: Sustained fighting; no major city taken = Watch

sources.title: Critical Threats — Congo War Security Review
allAfrica — Congolese refugees caught between war and closing doors

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
